summary_md: **jp ([@jeevanpillay](https://x.com/jeevanpillay/status/2115988345608122401))** discusses *A Mathematical Theory of the Jacobian Lens* ([arXiv 2610.31955](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.31955)), noting that the public fitting code weights lag d by (n−d)/n instead of equally as the theory assumes, and that his team is fitting per-offset Jacobians on Qwen3.5-4B.

referenced_urls.title: A Mathematical Theory of the Jacobian Lens

relevance: Interpretability theory with a practical implementation caveat.
